description: Animals that failed on a branch within the time window bounded by two commit SHAs. The window is defined by the earliest started_at observed for either SHA on that branch — not by git topological order, since the buildfarm tables don't carry commit ordering.

end_sha.description: Later commit SHA (window upper bound), or a commit URL (gitweb, git.postgresql.org, GitHub, pg.ddx.io)

start_sha.description: Earlier commit SHA (window lower bound), or a commit URL (gitweb, git.postgresql.org, GitHub, pg.ddx.io)

name: find_breaks
